test_title: PYST 62: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held On 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

'A x B' means ‘A is the son of B’,

'A – B' means ‘A is the brother of B’,

'A + B' means ‘A is the wife of B’,

'A % B' means ‘A is the father of B’.

How is M related to T if ‘M + N x P % S – T’?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png]

 to B
 
 

Given: M + N x P % S – T

M + N → M is the wife of N.

N x P → N is the son of P.

P % S → P is the father of S.

S – T → S is the brother of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7c4c3414852d170044892820d5e3c170fcebcdb6eb4fbdfab7962c09bc152b96.png] 

Thus, M is the sister-in-law or brother's wife of T.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
